ISHAAN VOHRA

Senior Software Engineer

JOB OBJECTIVE To excel professionally by leveraging expertise in software development, IT, and project management within esteemed organizations, preferably in Pune.

EDUCATION

Bachelors of Technology in Electronics and Communication, 2017

CORE COMPETENCIES Software Development Lifecycle Agile Methodologies Project Management Requirement Analysis Integration Strategies Business Process Enhancement Quality Assurance Practices System Architecture Design Data Security Measures Client Relationship Management

TECHNICAL SKILLS Backend Stack: Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Kafka, REST, Multithreading Basics, Python Basics Database: PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, MS SQL, Couchbase Cloud (Basics): Microsoft Azure Fundamentals, AWS Cloud Practitioner Essentials Frameworks and Libraries: Reactive WebFlux, ProtoBuf, ActiveMQ, Karate Tests IDE/Tools: IntelliJ, Eclipse, Postman, Maven, JIRA, Tomcat, SonarQube, Openshift Cloud Platform, Conduktor, Kafka Offset Explorer Devops: Jenkins, Dockers Basic Version Control: GIT

+91 7498264367

devanshvohra95@gmail.com

linkedin.com/in/ishaan-vohra- 29dec1995

PROFILE SUMMARY

Accomplished Senior Software Engineer with over 8 years of experience in software development, specializing in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, and cloud-native architectures. Proficient in designing and building scalable RESTful APIs, implementing Kafka-based messaging systems, and optimizing performance using SQL/NoSQL databases. Proven success in leading cross-functional teams, conducting code reviews, and mentoring junior developers to maintain high engineering standards. Strong command of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) and containerization technologies like Docker and OpenShift, ensuring secure and efficient deployments. Consistently recognized for driving innovation, delivering high-impact solutions like the Gov-Certification and API Migration projects, and improving system efficiency by measurable margins.









WORK EXPERIENCE

Duration Jul'2023 to Present

Designation Senior Software Engineer

Company SailPoint Technologies

Location Pune

Mar'2021 to Jun’ 2023

Software Engineer - Advanced

Amdocs Development Centre India LLP

Pune

June 2017 – March 2021

Senior Software Engineer

Confluxsys Pvt. Ltd.

Pune

PROJECTS UNDERTAKEN

SailPoint Technologies Senior Software Engineer | July 2023 – Present Domain: Identity Security | Architecture: Microservices

Project: Gov-Certification (Certs 2.0) | Jul 2023 – Present Tech: Java 8, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Redis, Kafka, Karate Tests , MapStruct, Lombok, AWS, Outbox Pattern •

Contributed to backend development for a next-gen access review system, replacing legacy CMS.

Developed scalable APIs with Redis/Kafka-based asynchronous flows. •

Implemented business logic improvements and database interactions via PostgreSQL and Snowflake.

Utilized Karate tests framework for API test automation. • Resolved QA-raised defects through iterative hotfixes.

Project: Certifications GxP | Mar 2024 – May 2024 Tech: Java 8, Spring Boot, MapStruct, Snowflake, GoLang (exposure) •

Led development of GxP-compliant approval workflows with e-signature enforcement.

Built backend services, integrated Snowflake DB, and handled feature releases. • Collaborated with product owner, cross functional teams, prepared HLD and LLD.

Project: Machine Account Certification | Feb 2024 – Mar 2024 Tech: Java 8, Spring Boot, MySQL • Delivered core functionality for certifying machine (non-human) identities. •

Implemented identity checks and data persistence via MySQL.

Project: API Migration (Beta to V3) | Dec 2023 – Feb 2024 Tech: Java 8, Spring Boot, MySQL, LaunchDarkly, Karate Tests • Managed complete migration of APIs using feature flags for version rollout. • Updated documentation, test cases, and API gateway configurations. • Ensured backward compatibility and stakeholder alignment.

AWARDS & HIGHLIGHTS

Received Outstanding Project Management recognition at SailPoint Technologies. • Honored with Excellence Award for innovative ServiceNow integration at Confluxsys. Led SailPoint–Decision Support Platform integration, enhancing access validation.



Deployed Continuous Access



Governance, reducing spurious accounts and strengthening security. Implemented Risk-Based Approval workflows to ensure compliance and boost data protection.

CERTIFICATIONS • Microsoft Certified Azure

Fundamentals

Udemy-Entry Level Python Programmer

Amdocs Development Centre India LLP Software Engineer – Advanced | March 2021 – June 2023 Domain: Telecom | Architecture: Microservices

Project: Proposal and Agreement | Oct 2022 – Jun 2023 Tech: Java 8, Spring Boot, Kafka, Couchbase, MapStruct, CompletableFuture • Developed microservices to digitize B2B sales workflows from proposal to

agreement.

Utilized CompletableFuture for parallel processing and Kafka for event-driven flow.

Project: Order Handling | Mar 2021 – Jul 2022 Tech: Java 8, Spring Boot, Kafka, OpenShift, Couchbase, Reactive Pattern • Built reactive REST APIs and asynchronous services to manage customer orders. • Diagnosed FIT issues and collaborated on root cause resolutions.

Project: Data ETL Tool | Aug 2022 – Oct 2022 Tech: Java 8, Spring Boot, Couchbase, OpenShift • Created ETL tool to transfer configuration datasets across environments. • Enabled traceability and debugging via RESTful endpoints and NoSQL storage.

Confluxsys Senior Software Engineer | June 2017 – March 2021 Domain: Identity & Access Management (IAM) | Architecture: Microservices

Project: Decision Support Platform – SailPoint Integration | Nov 2018 – Mar 2021 Tech: SailPoint, Java 7/8, Spring, Hibernate, REST, Docker, ActiveMQ • Built a user access revalidation engine integrating with SailPoint. • Developed custom SailPoint plugins/tasks and led feature release planning. • Managed production support and client-reported issues.

Project: Continuous Access Governance | Apr 2018 – Oct 2018 Tech: Java 7, Spring, JavaScript, REST APIs, ServiceNow • Developed out-of-band access attestation platform. • Built ServiceNow workflows, SLAs, and Java-based integration libraries.

Project: Risk-Based Approval Workflow | Dec 2017 – Mar 2018 Tech: Java 7, Spring, REST APIs, JavaScript, ServiceNow •

Created approval engine for high-risk access changes with ServiceNow integration.

Project: Manual Fulfillment & Access Revocation | Aug 2017 – Nov 2017 Tech: Java 7, Spring, REST APIs, JavaScript, ServiceNow •

Implemented modules to track access revocations and automate ServiceNow ticketing.

Maintained reusable Java libraries for streamlined request processing.
